observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console with a 'Star Wars' theme sticker on top.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible on the front left and right sides.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not a Pro, based on the size and design.
The 'Star Wars' sticker is not a standard PS4 design; it is a custom or third-party decal.
The console shows some dust and minor wear, especially on the top surface.
No games are visible in either photo.
The seller claims 13 games are included, but none are shown.

claims.evidence: The console's size and design in photos 0 and 1 are consistent with a standard PS4, not a PS4 Pro. The PS4 Pro is larger and has a different design.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are clearly visible on top of the console in both photos.
No games are visible in the photos. The claim cannot be verified from the images provided.

risks.risk: Console may not be a PS4 Pro, but a standard PS4
risks.proof: A clear shot of the console's model label or a comparison with a known PS4 Pro unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4, which is lower than a PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or damaged
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers powering on and connecting to the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional or damaged controllers.

risks.risk: Games may not be included or may be damaged
risks.proof: Photos of all 13 games in their cases or digital proof of their availability.

risks.risk: Console may have internal damage or software issues
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up and running a game.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the box showing the model, serial or service tag.
A clear photo of the model label on the back or bottom of the console.
A video showing both controllers powering on and connecting to the console.
Photos of all 13 games included, or proof of their digital availability.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
